Subject: Order form questions: net terms exception & tax withholding

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Acme Ops is keen to move forward but procurement has two asks before we can sign: 1) a net-60 payment term (our standard is 60 days) instead of Redwood's default net-30, and 2) clarity in the Order Form that Acme can withhold local taxes and remit them to our tax authority.

We also need invoices to be issued to the Acme US entity (Acme Ops Inc.) rather than the broader group, and proof of Redwood's tax residency (W-8/W-9 equivalent) so our tax team can clear vendor setup. Please advise whether Redwood can:
- accept net-60 or provide a compromise cadence;
- include language on tax withholding and invoice entity in the Order Form;
- share SOC2 cert and a short tax form we can use for vendor setup.

Attaching a sample PO for format reference (Acme_PO_Sample.pdf). We are lining up a PO once terms are agreed.

Best,
Sofia Reyes
Procurement Manager, Acme Ops

Sofia / Lauren / team —

Proposal from Redwood to bridge procurement/finance constraints:
- Net-45 payment terms (compromise between Net-30 and Net-60);
- 12-month minimum commit (USD value) billed quarterly in arrears;
- Invoices can be issued to Acme Ops Inc. (US entity) with a field for Acme PO number;
- Include an Appendix A in the Order Form where Acme can attach tax evidence (W-8/W-9 or local equivalent) and Redwood agrees to provide a standard tax residency attestation;
- For withholding: Redwood requests that any withheld amounts be documented on the remittance advice and a copy of withholding evidence submitted to Redwood within 30 days; Redwood will provide net-of-withholding credits where applicable.

I've attached my redline (orderform-redline_karthik.docx) that implements the above. Key asks of Acme: confirm acceptance of net-45 and the quarterly invoicing cadence, and confirm that issuing invoices to Acme Ops Inc. is acceptable across your AP/ERP.

Ben — can you confirm that quarterly invoicing to an entity (vs consolidated group invoice) is OK for our revenue recognition and AR?

Marissa — please advise if Appendix A is sufficient for evidence handling or if Legal wants a different mechanism.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, s.reyes@acme-ops.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 Jun 2028 09:08:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form questions: net terms exception & tax withholding

Team / Sofia —

I reviewed Karthik's proposed redline. High-level legal feedback:
1) Net-45 is acceptable from a risk standpoint but we should add a conditional clause: exception granted subject to no outstanding past-due invoices and final signature on the attached Order Form. This protects us if the account falls into delinquency.
2) Appendix A for tax evidence is reasonable. We should require Acme to provide (a) a valid tax residency certificate and (b) evidence of the withholding amount and remittance when applied. Redwood will retain the right to request additional documentation for tax audits.
3) For invoice entity: we can issue to Acme Ops Inc. but need a billing contact and billing address on the Order Form to satisfy AR workflow; include a required field for the legal entity name, tax ID, and PO number.
4) Add a short warranty/indemnity carveout clarifying that any local tax withholding arising from Acme's instructions is the customer's responsibility and Redwood will credit amounts only upon receipt of remittance evidence.

I've prepared legal markups (redline_legal_markups.pdf) attached — main changes are limited to Section 2 (Payment), Section 9 (Tax), and Appendix A language. If Acme agrees, we can bake these into the DocuSign packet and route for signature.

Lauren / Karthik — recommend we lock commercial terms and then have Ben approve invoice schedule to avoid delays in implementation.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clarity.

Acme accepts Net-45 and the quarterly in-arrears billing on the condition that invoices are issued to Acme Ops Inc. with a populated PO number field; procurement confirmed PO_78934 will be used for the first invoice (attached).

On withholding: Acme will provide tax evidence and remittance notice within 30 days of any withholding event. Procurement asked that Redwood issue invoices dated to the billing entity (Acme Ops Inc.) so our AP system can auto-match — Ben, please confirm this works on your end.

We are ready to receive the DocuSign packet with the Appendix A included. Once executed we will push the PO and activate the vendor.

Best,
Sofia
